تعاملت (form VI)
# تَعَامَلْتُ (taʕāmaltu) /ta.ʕaː.mal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
# تَعَامَلْتَ (taʕāmalta) /ta.ʕaː.mal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
# تَعَامَلْتِ (taʕāmalti) /ta.ʕaː.mal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
# تَعَامَلَتْ (taʕāmalat) /ta.ʕaː.ma.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
